text:
maria: Quick idea — midweek sips & singalong. Thu or Fri after work? Rooftop bar (drinks) or office lounge + mocktails + snacks + a tiny open-mic? Budget ~$15-25. Who's in?
jake: Thu for me. Rooftop sounds perfect :beer: I can bring a portable speaker.
lin: Fri works better but rooftop > lounge. Happy to check capacity and bribe security with cookies :cookie:
olivia: Office lounge + snacks from me — quieter option. Also please include non-alc options :+1:
amy: Remote here — can we do a virtual karaoke room too? 7pm start ok.
maria: Cool. Sounds like mixed preferences. Plan: poll for Thu vs Fri, and an RSVP for rooftop vs lounge. I'll ping ops to see if rooftop's available.
devops-bot: @maria Requested rooftop availability: run `reserve-rooftop --date 2026-04-02 --time 19:00-22:00`. Waiting for ops approval. :gear:
jake: If rooftop's a no-go, lounge + karaoke hybrid works. I can run the Zoom room.
lin: I'll grab snacks if we do lounge. Vegan options too.
maria: Thanks — I'll post a 2-question poll (date + venue) later today and a quick RSVP thread. If rooftop is free, we'll do rooftop + hybrid stream so remote folks can join. :sparkles:
